# Intent-graph harness — after R1

Generated by `cargo test -p ratel-ai-core --lib harness_report -- --ignored`.
Fixtures: `turns.json` (50 turns, 47 distinct queries), `catalog.json` (26 ops).

**Absolute numbers mean little — only deltas between runs on this fixture do.** One
embedding model, two domains, labels assigned by one person, and the same turns both
build and evaluate the graph, so this measures whether a change altered behaviour, not
whether it generalises.

Compare against `harness-baseline.md`, the frozen pre-R1 capture, by diffing the two
files. Nothing here restates those numbers: a hardcoded summary goes stale the moment
the fixtures change, and says so silently.

**Read-phrased queries served a write op at top-1: 3 of 25.** This is the reported failure, measured end to end.
